verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents an official CLI, SDK and REST API covering the full instance lifecycle. Its CLI walkthrough explicitly covers searching for a GPU, renting it, waiting for boot, connecting, copying data and cleaning up. A runtime probe confirmed `create instance` and `destroy instance` in the command surface, and an official agent skill lets AI assistants create and manage instances. Missing for 10: no hands-on end-to-end run that actually created and destroyed an instance (only keyless search was exercised); monitoring beyond show_instances and boot-wait is thinly documented; account signup and credit top-up are documented only as console steps; no official MCP server is evidenced (an agent skill instead).

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can provision a GPU, monitor it, run a workload, and tear it down end to end through documented APIs, CLI, or MCP without a human in the console

citations.quote: search for a GPU, rent it, wait for it to boot, connect to it, copy data, and clean up
The Vast.ai CLI gives you command-line access to the entire platform, authentication, GPU search, instance lifecycle, templates, volumes, serverless endpoints, and more.
`vastai --help` prints the full command surface including search offers, create instance, and destroy instance.
The `vastai` agent skill lets AI coding assistants drive Vast.ai on your behalf — create instances, deploy endpoints, manage SSH keys, check balances, and more
Anything you can do in the web console, you can automate from your terminal.
